parameters.query:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT id, title, company, location, url, score, source, matched_keywords, first_seen,
    CASE
      WHEN country = 'us' THEN 'United States'
      WHEN country IN ('de','at','ch','nl','fr','gb','pl','es','it','ie','se','dk','no',
                       'fi','pt','cz','sk','si','hu','ro','bg','gr','hr','ee','lv','lt',
                       'lu','be','mt','cy','is') THEN 'Europe'
      ELSE 'Remote / Global'
    END AS bucket
  FROM jobs
  WHERE status = 'new'
    AND score >= 55
    AND digested_at IS NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY c.bucket ORDER BY c.score DESC, c.first_seen DESC
  ) AS bucket_rank
  FROM candidates c
),
picks AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked
  WHERE (bucket = 'Europe'          AND bucket_rank <= 8)
     OR (bucket = 'United States'   AND bucket_rank <= 6)
     OR (bucket = 'Remote / Global' AND bucket_rank <= 6)
),
needed AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(0, 20 - (SELECT count(*) FROM picks)) AS n
),
spare AS (
  SELECT b.* FROM (
    SELECT r.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY r.score DESC, r.first_seen DESC) AS fill_rank
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM picks p WHERE p.id = r.id)
  ) b
  CROSS JOIN needed
  WHERE b.fill_rank <= needed.n
)
SELECT id, title, company, location, url, score, source, matched_keywords, bucket
FROM (
  SELECT id, title, company, location, url, score, source, matched_keywords, bucket, 1 AS tier FROM picks
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, title, company, location, url, score, source, matched_keywords, bucket, 2 AS tier FROM spare
) t
ORDER BY tier,
  CASE bucket WHEN 'Europe' THEN 1 WHEN 'United States' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
  score DESC;
